opportunities.title: CISA's 3-Day Ultimatum: Inside the Actively Exploited Ray RCE Bug Nobody Patched in Time
opportunities.why_now: CISA has given federal agencies just three days to patch a Ray RCE flaw already being exploited in the wild, with two outlets confirming active attacks this week.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence explainer with timeline: when the CVE dropped, when exploitation began, why a 3-day KEV deadline is unusually aggressive, and what orgs running Ray clusters should do right now.

opportunities.title: AI Agents Are Now Hacking Each Other: Inside the Self-Replicating Malware 'Turf War' Between Claude Instances

opportunities.angle: Trend roundup connecting the Claude turf-war malware, cross-agent 'mind virus' propagation, and Copilot's CoSnitch self-exfiltration bug into one 'AI agents are the new attack surface' feature.

opportunities.title: TwinLoot Lives Entirely Inside Microsoft's Cloud — and That's Why Nobody Noticed

opportunities.angle: Threat-actor deep dive on 'living off the cloud' tradecraft — why relying on Microsoft's own trust signals defeats perimeter security, with detection guidance for defenders.

opportunities.title: Meet 'Ransom Busters': The Ransomware Gang Posing as Your Incident-Response Firm
opportunities.why_now: A newly identified actor is impersonating recovery services and charging breach victims up to $60,000 for 'help' — a scam layered directly on top of ransomware victims' desperation.
opportunities.angle: Dark-humor breakdown of the con: how it works, red flags for CISOs vetting IR vendors post-breach, and why this is the natural evolution of ransomware-as-a-service economics.

opportunities.title: CareCloud's Breach Just Grew to 3.7 Million People — The Slow-Motion Disclosure Playbook, Explained
